data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'haba' which means 'to give' or 'to give as a gift'. In Islamic culture, it is believed that every child is a precious gift from Allah. Thus, the name Habeekah symbolizes the idea of a child being a blessing and a gift from Allah.
